subject: Anchor shift and cross-role impacts — Q2 calibration pre-brief
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: hr-ops@talentplus.com
Date: 2027-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Anchor shift and cross-role impacts — Q2 calibration pre-brief

Team —

Ahead of Friday's calibration, I pulled together a short set of proposed anchor adjustments and a matrix of role-swapped contributors that will affect cross-team comparisons. The workbook is attached (Q2_anchor_changes.xlsx) and I added an "impact notes" tab for the three cases I want us to flag:

- Two ICs who moved teams mid-cycle (formal role swap between Platform and Runtime).
- One manager promoted in November with a partial ramp — ambiguous for band placement.
- A set of matrixed contributors who spent >40% time on another product line.

Ask: please review the attachments and add brief comments in the "proposed" column by 4pm PT today. For the role-swapped ICs I propose we use a "soft anchor" so their rating reflects prior contributions but also accounts for transition overhead — details in row 23–36.

I expect some pushback on the manager case (raises & promotion timing). If you think it needs an executive exception, note that in your comments and we'll put it on the short pre-brief agenda.

I've looped HR Ops (cc) for recordkeeping and to surface any audit concerns early.

Thanks —

Karthik Iyer
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_anchor_changes.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Anchor shift and cross-role impacts — Q2 calibration pre-brief

Thanks Karthik — skimmed the workbook. A few quick notes:

- I agree with the soft-anchor approach for the two role-swapped ICs, but we should standardize what "soft" means (e.g., baseline anchor + discretionary delta up to 0.25 band).
- For the promoted manager: the promotion effective date (11/15/26) means they had ~3 full months at manager level before review. I would lean toward anchoring at the manager median with a note that we’ll re-evaluate at the mid-year check if performance suggests drift.
- Matrixed contributors: we need to make sure their contributions to Stellar Labs integration are captured; I cc'ed Bob Chang (external) in a separate thread earlier and he confirmed the integration milestones. That external confirmation could help justify cross-team credit.

I'll add inline cell comments in Q2_anchor_changes.xlsx.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Insights
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-03T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Anchor shift and cross-role impacts — Q2 calibration pre-brief

Karthik / Laura —

I added a complementary file (org_swap_matrix.csv) that maps the individuals to project-level deliverables and shows overlapping manager inputs. Key recommendations from my side:

1) Two-tier anchor: use the soft-anchor for role swaps but require a documented contribution letter from the origin team to avoid double-credit.
2) Manager promotion: propose a conditional uplift (manager median + 0.1) tied to an explicit PIP-style milestones list (3 items, 90 days). This avoids an immediate exception but recognizes the promotion.
3) Appeals path: given the sensitivity, let's offer managers a single written appeal window (5 business days) after final bands go out; appeals should include concrete evidence.

I also flagged two cases I think should be elevated to the exec calibration slot:
- Manager S (promotion timing + cross-team ownership)
- IC R (role swap + conflicting anchors between Platform and Runtime)

If we elevate, we should prep a 5-min readout each with a short recommendation and transcript of manager calibration notes.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, People Analytics
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org_swap_matrix.csv

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: hr-ops@talentplus.com
Date: 2027-04-04T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Anchor shift and cross-role impacts — Q2 calibration pre-brief

Appreciate the fast turn-around and the detailed matrices. Decisions / next steps: 

- We will adopt the two-tier soft-anchor approach for the two role-swapped ICs. Marissa, please capture the origin-team contribution note template and I'll sign off.
- For the promoted manager (Manager S): conditional uplift approved (manager median + 0.1) with the 90-day milestones. HR Ops, please confirm this is compliant with our compensation policy; if not, we will route to exec exception.
- Appeals window: 5 business days after distributions — Tessa, can you confirm comms language and timing?
- Exec slot: we will reserve the first 15 minutes of the calibration for the two elevated cases. Marissa, please prepare the 5-min readouts and add them to the prebrief agenda (prebrief-agenda.pdf).

I've added the Jira item for audit trace (HR-378) and the Drive link to the prebrief agenda in related_links. If no objections, I will lock the anchors at 9am PT Friday and share the pre-brief doc with Exec.

Thanks —

Karthik
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
